macros.name: cite
macros.doc: The traditional \cite command groups multi-key citations together (i.e. multiple numbers, separated by commas, can be found inside the square brackets). gcite groups multi-key citations similarly, outputting the minimal bibliographic details for each work in turn, then the grouped numeric citation at the end.
